mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id AS employeeId, contract_type AS contractType, contract_expire_date AS contractExpireDate, probation_salary_ratio AS probationSalaryRatio, scheme_id AS schemeId, base_salary AS baseSalary, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee_contract WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_contract (employee_id, contract_type, contract_expire_date, probation_salary_ratio, scheme_id, base_salary) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{contractType}, #{contractExpireDate}, #{probationSalaryRatio}, #{schemeId}, #{baseSalary})
